title: Adaptive Semantic Branching: Disagreement-Localized Cross-Trajectory Regeneration for Reasoning Candidate Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2611.07918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning trajectories generated for the same problem often arrive at conflicting answers. These disagreements reveal alternative intermediate decisions that can be reused to explore new solutions. We introduce Adaptive Semantic Branching (ASB), a training-free inference procedure that turns cross-trajectory disagreement into targeted candidate generation. ASB first groups independently sampled trajectories by extracted final answer, selects a representative from each group, and aligns their reasoning steps with a monotonic dynamic program. A persistent-divergence objective identifies the point at which initially similar reasoning paths develop different continuations. For each selected directed pair, ASB retains the source trajectory's textual prefix, extracts a short reasoning window from a competing donor trajectory, and generates a fresh solution conditioned on both. translated_title: 自适应语义分支：面向推理候选扩展的分歧定位跨轨迹再生成
translated_abstract: 为同一问题生成的推理轨迹往往会得出相互冲突的答案。这些分歧揭示了可被复用以探索新解法的不同中间决策。我们提出了自适应语义分支（ASB），这是一种无需训练的推理流程，能够将跨轨迹分歧转化为有针对性的候选生成。ASB 首先根据提取出的最终答案对独立采样的轨迹进行分组，从每组中选出一个代表性轨迹，并使用单调动态规划对它们的推理步骤进行对齐。一个持续性分歧目标用于识别最初相似的推理路径在何处发展出不同的延续。对于每个选定的有向轨迹对，ASB 保留源轨迹的文本前缀，从竞争性供体轨迹中提取一个简短的推理窗口，并基于两者条件生成全新的解法。一种多样性感知策略会分配最多三次额外的生成机会。
tldr: 该论文提出了无需训练的自适应语义分支（ASB）方法，通过定位不同推理轨迹间的分歧点并融合分歧处的推理内容来再生成新的候选解法，从而有效扩展推理候选的多样性与质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Adaptive Semantic Branching (ASB), a training-free inference method that localizes disagreement points across reasoning trajectories and regenerates new candidate solutions by conditioning on fused reasoning content from divergent trajectories, thereby effectively expanding the diversity and quality of reasoning candidates.
